desc:
Some projects need more than pages and posts. Ecom Swift LLC plans and builds WordPress membership and multisite builds, plus custom post types with their own fields, in your hosting account and tests every user role before handover.

## What are WordPress membership and multisite builds?

A membership build limits parts of a WordPress site to people who register or pay. A multisite build runs several sites from one WordPress installation and one dashboard. A custom post type is a new kind of content, such as a property, a course or a team member, with its own fields and its own archive page.

These three features go beyond a standard brochure site. They change how data is stored, who can see what and how editors work every day, so they need planning before anyone installs a plugin.

## Why advanced structure matters

A site that grows without a plan turns into a pile of pages that nobody can maintain. Listings end up inside ordinary posts, members share one login, and every new section is copied by hand from an old one. The result is slow editing, mistakes in who can see paid content and a layout that breaks whenever something changes.

A planned structure does the opposite. Each type of content has a clear home, each kind of visitor has a clear role, and your team knows where to click. That is the difference between a site that supports the business and one that the business works around.

## How it affects leads, revenue and time

Membership access gives you a way to keep content, courses or resources behind a login and to offer free and paid levels side by side. When access and payments are connected, new members get in without anyone sending links by email, which saves your team time and avoids mistakes.

Custom content types help visitors find things. A filter on a property list or a course catalog lets a buyer narrow results in seconds. Multisite saves effort for groups of related sites, such as regional branches, because updates and users are managed in one place. Results still depend on your offer, your content and your traffic.

## What a strong advanced build includes

- A written structure plan listing every content type, field, role and access rule before building starts.
- Custom post types with clean field labels, so editors see forms that make sense.
- Archive and single templates that match your theme and work on phones.
- Search and filter controls on the fields visitors actually use.
- Login, registration, password reset and account pages that look like part of your site.
- Restricted content rules that hide protected pages from search listings and from non-members.
- Welcome and confirmation emails written in plain words.
- A multisite network with shared themes and separate sites, where that suits you.
- An admin view that shows your team new entries and members at a glance.
- Notes for editors, so adding an entry never needs a developer.

## How we work

Every project opens with a brief planning stage. You describe who uses the site and what each group should see, and we turn that into a simple map of roles and content types. We confirm the map with you before building.

Next we build in your own hosting account, using well-maintained plugins where they do the job and custom code where they do not. We test with sample entries, then log in as each role to confirm that each one sees only what it should. The Basic package covers one planned feature. Standard adds a membership area or a small multisite. Premium covers a larger build with payments, several content types and admin tools.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Decide your access levels on paper before building.
- Start with the smallest set of fields that visitors really need.
- Test every role, including a logged-out visitor.
- Keep a staging copy for future changes.
- Plan how existing members or listings will be imported.

**Avoid:**
- Stacking several membership plugins that overlap.
- Putting protected content in places search engines can read.
- Adding fields nobody will fill in.
- Sharing one admin login across your team.
- Going live without a test purchase or test registration.

## Who it is for

Training providers can place lessons behind a login and sell access by level. Property or vehicle sellers can list items with filters instead of copying text into pages. Organizations with several branches or brands can run each site separately while managing everything from one place.

## How to get started

Send us a short description of the site, who will use it and what each group should see. Examples of similar sites you like help us understand the layout. We never need your password. We work as a collaborator, administrator or developer user in your WordPress and hosting accounts, which you can remove at any time. You pay your host and any plugin makers directly, and our package covers the work only.
